name: Revitalizing Handgrip
description: Fit a second spur beside the first on the board's tail, so two dart butts can sit together.

name: Spurrespite
description: Seat two darts on the double spur with one press of the thumb.

name: Chime Dartshaft
description: Pick two darts of equal weight and length by feel, so they fly as a true pair.

name: Booming Whipover
description: Loose both darts at once along flat lines a hand's width apart.

name: Rumblespur
description: Send the twin darts apart at release, one to each of two foes standing close together.

name: Cupendwrath
description: Loose the twin darts a heartbeat apart, so the second finds the foe already reacting to the first.

name: Unbowed Throwstick
description: Cross two loaded shafts before the body to turn aside a sword cut.

name: Facet Throwlever
description: Bind the twin darts with qi so both strike as one and punch through heavy guard.

name: Webbing Cupend
description: Pin both of a foe's sleeve cuffs to a wall with twin darts, keeping his hands from his weapon.

name: Eviscerating Spurhook
description: Run qi down both spurs and loose the pair as one great stroke that overwhelms a foe's strongest guard.

name: Vigilant Weightstone
description: Survey the basin floor from its rim, noting every slope, ditch and clump of cover.

name: Vital Gripbinding
description: Gather a dozen darts in the crook of the free arm, ready to feed the board.

name: Cupvigil
description: Lean back and plant the feet so the throw goes upward at a steep angle.

name: Spurwrath
description: Heave a dart nearly straight up so it falls on a mark far across the basin.

name: Cupflash
description: Walk the basin's rim between casts so the rain falls from a new side each time.

name: Glint Extend
description: Cast each dart a little farther than the last, walking the fall up the basin like a ladder.

name: Unsparing Leverage
description: Lob a dart to fall straight down behind a wall of shields or a low bank.

name: Galvanizing Fingerhooks
description: Count a steady cadence of casts so the shower never thins and never surges.

name: Obdurate Weightstone
description: Drop below the basin rim between volleys to stay out of the answering fire.

name: Mayhem Whipover
description: Hold the board overhead as qi gathers, then loose a great shower over a wide stretch of the basin.

name: Grievous Overarm
description: Lay a thick line of falling darts across a pass or ford so no foe dares cross it.

name: Extendhavoc
description: Let darts fall in an unbroken sheet over the whole basin until foes break and seek the rim.

name: Energizing Dartshaft
description: Hold the board tight against the flank with the elbow pinned, giving no sign of an arm about to throw.

name: Remnant Spurhook
description: Hold perfectly still and watch until the foe's attention drifts, then act.

name: Lacerating Throwstick
description: Snap the board forward from the pinned stance, and the dart is gone before the arm is seen.

name: Murk Whipover
description: Twitch the free shoulder while the board arm stays pinned, drawing the foe's guard to the wrong side.

name: Mangling Atlshaft
description: Pick out a gap in the foe's guard with a hawk's eye and drive a dart exactly through it.

name: Vanishing Flexshaft
description: Leave the cast spot without a sound, so no foe can say where the dart came from.

name: Nova Throwstick
description: Strike from the closed stance so fast and plain that armor and guard are caught half-raised.

name: Escalating Overarm
description: Cast once from the closed stance, then again at the moment the foe reacts to the first.

name: Propelscourge
description: Stand unmoving until the instant of opening, then cast with the whole stored force of the body in one stroke.

name: Resurgent Gripbinding
description: Breathe in time with a run along the river bank, so the cast never waits on a winded chest.

name: Prescient Dartshaft
description: Read the wake and splash of a fleeing foe to see how fast he goes and where he turns.

name: Torrent Atlshaft
description: Run through ankle-deep water on the balls of the feet, keeping the board arm steady.

name: Wrathful Extend
description: Cast over the water at a fleeing foe on the far side, lifting the arc above the current's haze.

name: Cupinsight
description: Wipe a wet dart on the sleeve to restore the grip and keep the seat dry.

name: Ruinous Whipover
description: Cast at the heels of a runner so the dart takes the trailing foot and breaks his pace.

name: Propelblink
description: Run along the opposite bank at the foe's speed, keeping him in the line of throw.

name: Gust Throwlever
description: Lead a swimmer or boatman by the drift of the current, casting where the water will carry him.

name: Strangling Handgrip
description: Pin a runner's cloak with a cast from behind, then loose another to anchor him to the bank.

name: Leverage Reckoning
description: Throw darts across the ford in steady beats, so no pursued foe can cross it.

name: Novaspur
description: After a long pursuit, loose one dart with the stored force of the whole run to end the chase.

name: Buoying Atlshaft
description: Call the count aloud with a partner, so both throwers loose on the same beat.

name: Impervious Handgrip
description: Stand back to back with a partner, each guarding the other's blind side.

name: Intent Cupend
description: Hand fresh darts to a partner without looking, so the volley need never pause.

name: Extendruin
description: Cast on the same arc as a partner, so two darts fall as one.

name: Headlong Overarm
description: Exchange places with a partner in one smooth step, keeping both lines of throw open.

name: Spurhavoc
description: Throw from two sides at a single mark, so no guard can face both.

name: Gnashing Throwlever
description: Cast on the offbeat of a partner's cast, so the foe hears no pause in which to move.

name: Murk Gripbinding
description: Cast a dart to knock aside a missile aimed at a partner's back.

name: Verityspur
description: Feel a partner's rhythm by qi-sense and fit your own casts to it.

name: Brutalizing Whipover
description: Pour paired volleys onto one foe from two angles until his guard has no clear side.

name: Synchronized Weightstone
description: Weave two throwers' volleys into one long chain, each cast opening the way for the next.

name: Aura Throwstick
description: Pass a pulse of qi from one thrower to the other through touching boards, doubling the partner's cast.

name: Titanic Whipover
description: Two throwers hold their casts for the same count, then loose them together in a storm over a wide patch.

name: Unerring Fingerhooks
description: Check that two darts match in weight and fletch so they will mirror each other in flight.

name: Elevating Spurhook
description: Load one dart to lead and one to follow on the same board.

name: Cupendruin
description: Release two darts with opposed spins so they curve apart and then back together.

name: Dazzling Gripbinding
description: Step in mirror to the first dart's path so the body is ready for the second.

name: Propelhavoc
description: Cast one dart high as bait for the foe's guard and the second low beneath it.

name: Chime Overarm
description: Where a foe's guard swings out, cast the dart on the opposite side, mirroring his move.

name: Illuminating Dartshaft
description: Hold both flights in qi-sense at once and judge which dart will land first.

name: Gyve Cupend
description: Cast two darts to pin both sides of a foe's cloak, so he cannot turn either way.

name: Confluent Throwlever
description: Cast the first dart to force a block, and loose the second into the opened guard.

name: Cupscourge
description: Loose two mirrored darts as a single stroke, so the second strikes the wound of the first.

name: Might Weightstone
description: Whisper the casting oath into the wind and feel the arm settle.

name: Radiant Handgrip
description: Stake an unseen bearing line across the plateau and cast only along it.

name: Aegis Spurhook
description: Plant the windward foot ahead and lean into the gale, rooting the stance.

name: Cupruin
description: Cast once the oath is spoken, with the dart bound to fly the line sworn.

name: Cupglimmer
description: Withdraw one pace for each phrase of the oath, never faster than the words.

name: Shattering Extend
description: Throw a dart that holds its bearing against a crosswind that would bend a lesser cast.

name: Ferocious Whipover
description: Call the oath again and loose a second dart onto the same bearing as the first.

name: Ghosting Handgrip
description: Cast on the move across the plateau's open ground, never slowing the stride.

name: Gyve Throwlever
description: Pin a foe by the hem on the bearing line, so he cannot leave the line of fire.

name: Blistering Propel
description: Drive a dart through a howling gale by the strength of the oath, striking true where others miss.

name: Ironspur
description: Hold the vow through a long breath as qi gathers, then cast the single dart the oath was sworn on.

name: Waning Fingerhooks
description: Read the dark edge of a storm front to learn when the gale will rise and from where.

name: Flintlike Cupend
description: Crouch low with the board close to the chest so the rising wind cannot wrest it away.

name: Titanic Throwstick
description: Cast at the surge of a gust, letting the wind add its push to the arm's.

name: Rampaging Leverage
description: Correct each cast for the squall's lashing, aiming into the rain and trusting the bearing.

name: Spurinsight
description: Mark a foe by qi-sense when rain and spray hide him from the eye.

name: Silt Dartshaft
description: Sidestep with the gust's push and let it carry the thrower out of the line of fire.

name: Rumble Whipover
description: Hold the cast until the strongest gust, then loose a dart that rides it far beyond the arm's range.

name: Merciless Extend
description: Cast volley after volley from behind the rain's curtain, so foes cannot tell the direction of the fall.

name: Propelwrath
description: Gather qi until the wind itself joins the throw, and loose darts that sweep a wide stretch of ground.

name: Unconquered Weightstone
description: Stand with open air at the back and trust the stance, for no wall will hold the thrower up.

name: Clairvoyant Flexshaft
description: Keep the eyes wide on the whole horizon and miss no movement at its edge.

name: Gripbinding Vigil
description: Load the board by touch in the open, with no table or crate to rest it on.

name: Pitiless Propel
description: Cast from open ground, honest and direct, with no cover to lean on.

name: Gust Atlshaft
description: Slide aside on the wind's push, leaving the foe's counter-cast to fall on empty ground.

name: Lightning Dartshaft
description: Turn on the spot and cast at each foe in turn when surrounded on open ground.

name: Punishing Leverage
description: Cast in a fanning sweep from left to right, each dart landing a pace wide of the last.

name: Glamour Throwstick
description: Throw from a ridge against the sun, so the foe loses the dart in the glare until it lands.

name: Evergreen Handgrip
description: Scuff dust with the lead foot and cast through the cloud it raises, hiding the thrower's arm.

name: Silt Overarm
description: Sweep darts in a broad arc across open ground until no foe has an unwatched flank.

name: Murkcup
description: Deflect incoming missiles with the board while casting back, using no cover at all.

name: Cupendscourge
description: With nothing behind and nothing to fear, put the full weight of the body into one cast no armor turns.

name: Vigilant Spurhook
description: Test the ground at the cliff rim with a toe before putting weight on it.

name: Discerning Dartshaft
description: Feel the wind rise up the face of the drop and judge how it will lift a dart.

name: Adamantine Throwstick
description: Crouch with a hand on the rock so a sudden gust cannot pitch the body over.

name: Booming Leverage
description: Cast outward off the rim so the rising wind lifts the dart's flight.

name: Extendblink
description: Step back from the rim just as the dart leaves, keeping the body clear of the drop.

name: Cupwrath
description: Cast steeply down the cliff face at foes climbing below.

name: Glint Overarm
description: Throw along the rim into the crosswind, letting it fan the darts across the climbers.

name: Charter Throwlever
description: Keep a steady fall of darts on the one path up the rim so none can climb it.

name: Lacerating Extend
description: Time the cast for a gust's peak at the rim, and the dart strikes with the wind's own force.

name: Facetpropel
description: Hold at the rim through the longest breath until the wind rises, then loose the cast that rides it down.

name: Healing Gripbinding
description: Count a small turn of the body between each cast, so every dart takes a fresh bearing.

name: Spurvigil
description: Turn the wrist a finger's width between casts to change the aim without moving the feet.

name: Torrential Cupend
description: Walk a slow circle around a foe while the board stays loaded and level.

name: Ruinous Throwstick
description: Cast the opening dart along a bearing the foe has no reason to guard.

name: Vigilant Fingerhooks
description: Mark each change of wind during a long volley and fold it into the next bearing.

name: Punishing Whipover
description: Cast a fan of darts, each on a fresh bearing, across the arc where the foe may flee.

name: Rampaging Overarm
description: Spiral outward from the foe's front to his flank with each cast, so he turns and turns again.

name: Reverie Atlshaft
description: Aim the body at one line and the dart at another, so the guard shifts the wrong way.

name: Clairvoyant Gripbinding
description: Keep every bearing of the volley in mind, so no line is repeated and none forgotten.

name: Spurruin
description: Pour darts on constantly changing bearings until the foe's guard can fix on none of them.

name: Immobilizing Handgrip
description: Cast darts that pin cloak, boot and sleeve on many bearings, tying the foe down on every side.

name: Slagcup
description: Turn a full circle with the board raised and loose darts to every bearing around the thrower.

name: Unsparing Overarm
description: After a long volley has drawn every guard aside, loose the one dart down the last open bearing.

name: Invincible Spurhook
description: Set the feet at the oath's width and swear to hold that ground.

name: Remnant Gripbinding
description: Name the distant mark aloud, binding the eye and the arm to it alone.

name: Elevating Dartshaft
description: Breathe slow and even under any threat, so the heartbeat never spoils the cast.

name: Gnashing Propel
description: Cast from the sworn stance without shifting a foot, aiming at the far mark.

name: Cupendrespite
description: Reload the board without stepping, drawing the next dart by feel.

name: Inexorable Handgrip
description: Hold the stance against a rain of darts, trusting qi in the legs to keep the body upright.

name: Shattering Throwlever
description: Raise the arc a little with each throw from the fixed stance until the fall lands on the mark.

name: Merciless Whipover
description: Answer a foe's cast at once with a dart down the same line from the same stance.

name: Extendscourge
description: Cast from perfect stillness with all qi stored in the stance, and the dart pierces at the edge of range.

name: Pitiless Overarm
description: Hold the stance and cast a steady rain at a distant ridge, until no foe will show above it.

name: Tempered Extend
description: Stand through a long silence as the oath gathers qi, then loose one dart that carries all of it across the distance.
